runtime.confidencePolicy: Argmax softmax; any token below floor blocks, never silently drops. Strict BIO, no orphan-I repair.
runtime.unmappedPolicy: block ambiguous_context; never relabel as a Mexican identifier
runtime.overflowPolicy: block; no truncation or window coverage claim
runtime.confidenceRationale: Upstream pinned card documents minScore=0.4. This adapter conservatively blocks any low-confidence token instead of dropping detections; not the upstream confidence policy or a tuned result.

limitations: No loaded ONNX tensor/operator compatibility or quality measurement.
No organization, case identifiers, indirect context or relationship labels; existing rules remain necessary and incomplete.
CITY/STATE and unsupported identifier types block, not auto-redact or silently preserve.
Ordinary dates are not interpreted as identifiers; mistaken model predictions remain possible.
Unlike upstream, no SSN/card/IP sentinel premasking or span repair is applied. This is a different preprocessing/policy candidate, not upstream benchmark reproduction.
Original Unicode offsets are preserved; UNK, token loss, malformed BIO, low confidence and inputs above512 tokens block.
No weights downloaded; metadata-only preparation. No app integration, egress grant or 8GB validation.

metadataAcquisition.verification: Pinned metadata checked against HF Git blob SHA1 for config/tokenizer/license; local SHA256 for all selected small files.
